## Dispatcher.supportedProtocols property

Returns array of protocol IDs that dispatcher is able to handle. Protocol ID format is PIURI specified at https://github.com/hyperledger/aries-rfcs/blob/main/concepts/0003-protocols/README.md\#piuri.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
get supportedProtocols(): string[];
```
